visual.name: bfusionBudgetRiskForecast
visual.description: Monte Carlo cost-at-risk simulation: total-cost probability S-curve, confidence-to-budget KPI, recommended contingency reserve, and top cost-risk drivers — derived from cost categories, no 3-point estimates required.

dataRoles.name: costCategory
dataRoles.description: Cost lines to roll up — e.g. CostCategory, CostType, or task/resource.

dataRoles.name: cost
dataRoles.description: Planned / likely cost per category. Summed across categories per trial.

dataRoles.name: budget
dataRoles.description: Optional approved budget. Drives the confidence-to-budget KPI and reserve gap.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

method.description: Monte Carlo (handles tails) vs closed-form analytical forecasts.

optimisticPct.description: Best-case cost as % below the planned value.

pessimisticPct.description: Worst-case cost as % above the planned value (overrun).

reserveConfidence.description: Percentile used for the contingency-reserve recommendation (e.g. 80).

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
